title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Implemented in Ireland by Trócaire, the programme contributes to outcome 5.1.3 Educators have increased confidence in using GCE methodologies with their learners and understand the links between GCE and their relevant curricula in early years, primary, post-primary and youth education. The objective is that existing GCE data and learning informs the learning support and learning products for educators and the GCE programmes for young people, through a data driven approach to programme quality. Key activities include ensuring robust and effective data gathering and analysis by having MEAL systems in place, which guarantee reflection and learning is constantly informing the programme.OBJECTIVES: Output 4: Existing GCE data and learning is informing the learning support and learning products for educators and the GCE programmes for young people through a data driven approach to programme qualityOUTCOMES:
